dataset.timezone: timestamps as stored in canonical source; session rules use America/New_York
dataset.contract_rollover: continuous MNQ series exactly as supplied in the Databento ZIP; unchanged from C1/C2

cpcv.groups: contiguous chronological groups with sizes differing by at most one bar
cpcv.secondary_rank_metric: mean(R)/sample_std(R), with zero when n<2 or std=0
cpcv.pbo_rule: for each path select the highest in-sample configuration (stable id tie-break); count failure when its out-of-sample rank is strictly below the cross-sectional median rank
cpcv.secondary_pbo_space: logit of the normalized OOS rank omega=(rank-0.5)/n_configs, lambda=log(omega/(1-omega)); failure iff lambda<0
cpcv.purge: remove every train trade whose closed [entry,exit] interval intersects any test-group bar interval
cpcv.embargo: remove train trades whose entry is in the 192 bars immediately following each test group
cpcv.separation: diagnostic of selection overfit and dispersion only; never an estimate of the causal walk-forward edge

gate4.protocol: one-parameter-at-a-time around each frozen center; every listed center and +/- point is run under rolling 36m train / 6m test / 6m step with h=192 purge/embargo audit and por_tramo accounting
gate4.decision: PASS/plateau iff every point has aggregate E[R]>0 and no point drops more than 40% relative to that subject's center E[R]; otherwise FAIL/spike
gate4.edge_rule: report whether the maximum observed E[R] lies at a low or high boundary for any varied parameter
gate4.integer_rounding: wait and cooldown are executor integers; +/-10% are rounded to nearest integer, half away from zero

base.slippage_legs: market entries plus stop and market/time exits; LIMIT and TP do not slip

scenarios.definition: commission and applicable por_tramo slippage multiplied by 1.25
commission and applicable por_tramo slippage multiplied by 1.50
0.25 points adverse on the complete entry quantity and complete exit quantity, including LIMIT and TP, plus base commission
for LIMIT strategies discard a trade when its fill-bar open is strictly through the limit in the favorable direction (long open<limit; short open>limit); market-entry strategies equal base
scenarios.justification: conservative no-fill treatment for gaps through resting limits

scenarios.definition: stop exits fill at the exit-bar open when it is worse than the stop, else at stop minus/plus base adverse slippage; report gap count; this is expected to match the existing executor's gap rule
scenarios.justification: funded-account tail loss from price gaps

scenarios.definition: chronological R transformed as r-0.10 for r>=0 and 1.25*r-0.10 for r<0; deterministic circular block bootstrap, block_length=40 trades, B=2000, master_seed=20260914
scenarios.justification: longer dependence blocks, degraded expectancy, and 25% heavier losses

scenarios.definition: within each fold keep chronological trade indices 0,2,4,... before concatenation
scenarios.justification: fixed non-outcome-selected loss of one in every two setups

gate7.series: chronological por_tramo OOS R from the unchanged 8-fold C2 walk-forward
gate7.verdict: FAIL iff eligibility.state is unsupported_or_inconclusive; otherwise PASS, while retaining dependence warnings and all rejecting tests
